stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

Preserve every other cell, including the original motif and zeros/background at non-motif positions inside the bounding box. Do not assume flood-fill or neighbor propagation: test motif translations when the grid visually consists of noisy background plus one seed object.
3. Use a small script to enumerate translations and construct output grids when manual scanning is error-prone. Validate by matching all demonstrated changed/unchanged cells; account for seed shape, legal translations within bounds, and any rotation/reflection only if supported by demonstrations.

Use demonstrations to identify which in-tile feature or count determines the output; do not assume every unusual cell or single marker is positive. For the task pattern with color-8 separators, 2×3 tiles containing mostly color 3 and occasional color 2, emit 1 for a tile with at least two 2s and 3 otherwise.
5. For sparse colored diagonal markers on a zero field, identify the invariant of their parallel lines: constant row−column for down-right diagonals, or row+column for down-left diagonals.
